title: Emerging antiferroelectric phases with fascinating dielectric, polarization and strain response in NaNbO3-(Bi0.5Na0.5)TiO3 lead-free binary system

lanes.label: Classical tools
lanes.sub: collapsed to one node per state

states.title: Hypothesis and design
states.head: Room-temperature phases and AFE stability across the whole NN-BNT binary system are unmapped; AFE order in BNT is hard to identify. Adding BNT to NN should stabilise the AFE P phase or bring the AFE R phase down to room temperature.
states.detail: Absorbed: n1 (HYP/gap), n2 (HYP/hypothesis), n3 (DES/base_system), n4 (DES/variable_sweep), n5 (PRC/forming). Premises: Pure NN's AFE P phase transforms irreversibly to FE at ~9 kV/mm, giving a square loop after the first cycle; NN polymorphs: P Pbma (AFE) -> R Pnma (AFE) at 360 C -> S Pnmm -> T1 Ccmm -> T2 P4/mbm -> cubic; BNT: R3c (FE) -> P4bm (AFE) at 260 C -> cubic at 540 C

states.title: Structure state
states.head: BNT keeps AFE_O Pbma to x=0.15, gives P+R coexistence near x=0.16 and single AFE_O Pnma (R) by x=0.18 at room temperature. Beyond x~0.3 the room-temperature phase runs PE_O Ccmm (x~0.35), PE_T P4/mbm (x~0.4), relaxor AFE_T P4bm (x~0.5-0.78), FE_R R3c (x>=0.85).
states.detail: Absorbed: n6 (STR/phase/identity), n7 (STR/phase/identity), n8 (STR/microstructure/feature_size). Premises: Superlattice types map to tilt systems: 1/4-order -> Pbma, 1/6-order -> Pnma, (h,2k,2l+1)/2 -> Ccmm, (2h+1,2k+1,2l)/2 -> a0a0c+ tetragonal, (2h+1,2k+1,2l+1)/2 -> R3c

states.title: Property state and mechanisms
states.head: From x>=0.1 the field-induced AFE-FE transition is reversible in polarization (double loops, near-zero remanence in cycle 2); NN switches irreversibly to FE. Only AFE_O R compositions (x>=0.16) repeat both P-E and S-E curves across cycles: the AFE-FE transition is fully reversible.
states.detail: Absorbed: n10 (PRP/behavior_class), n11 (PRP/behavior_class), n12 (MEC/pathway), n19 (PRP/value), n13 (PRP/behavior_class), n17 (MEC/pathway). Premises: A double P-E loop with two current peaks per half-cycle marks field-induced AFE-FE switching; a square loop with large Pr marks an FE state; Poled Pbma-type NN ceramics return to a metastable AFE phase that differs from the initial one

states.title: Performance state
states.head: NN-BNT AFE_O R ceramics near x=0.16 are candidates for large-strain actuators
states.detail: Absorbed: n15 (PRF/service_capability). Premises: A large strain that is fully recovered on every field cycle is what large-strain actuators require

states.title: Conclusion
states.head: Eight room-temperature phases appear in sequence with BNT content, incl. three AFE_O states of rising stability and a relaxor AFE_T P4bm, giving multiple AFE phase boundaries
